import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        int turnNum = sc.nextInt();
        
        int[] aliceChoices = new int[turnNum];
        for (int i = 0; i < turnNum; i++) {
            aliceChoices[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        
        int[] bobChoicesOriginal = new int[turnNum];
        for (int i = 0; i < turnNum; i++) {
            bobChoicesOriginal[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        
        // bobChoices.append(bobChoices.pop(0))
        int[] bobChoices = new int[turnNum];
        for (int i = 0; i < turnNum - 1; i++) {
            bobChoices[i] = bobChoicesOriginal[i + 1];
        }
        bobChoices[turnNum - 1] = bobChoicesOriginal[0];
        
        int minWin = 0;
        int maxWin = 0;
        
        // calculate the maximum number of rounds Alice can win
        for (int i = 0; i < turnNum; i++) {
            maxWin += Math.min(aliceChoices[i], bobChoices[i]);
        }
        
        // calculate the minimum number of rounds Alice can win
        int maxBob = -1;
        for (int choice : bobChoices) {
            if (choice > maxBob) maxBob = choice;
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < turnNum; i++) {
            if (bobChoices[i] == maxBob) {
                if (bobChoices[i] + aliceChoices[i] > minWin) {
                    minWin = bobChoices[i] + aliceChoices[i];
                }
            }
        }
        
        int maxAlice = -1;
        for (int choice : aliceChoices) {
            if (choice > maxAlice) maxAlice = choice;
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < turnNum; i++) {
            if (aliceChoices[i] == maxAlice) {
                if (aliceChoices[i] + bobChoices[i] > minWin) {
                    minWin = aliceChoices[i] + bobChoices[i];
                }
            }
        }
        
        minWin = (minWin > turnNum) ? minWin - turnNum : 0;
        
        System.out.println(minWin + " " + maxWin);
    }
}
